title: Nth Digit
summary: Determine the n-th digit in the sequence of all positive integers starting from 1.
statement: Determine the n-th digit in the sequence of all positive integers starting from 1.
constraints: Positions are one-based in the sequence 123456789101112... .
hints: Numbers with the same decimal width form a contiguous digit block.
Subtract complete 1-digit, 2-digit, and wider blocks until n lies inside one.
Use (n-1)//width to locate the number and (n-1)%width to select its digit.
Subtracting whole blocks preserves the one-based position within the remaining width group.
editorial: Subtracting whole blocks preserves the one-based position within the remaining width group.

tests.explanation: Positions ten and eleven are the digits 1 and 0 of number 10.
